title: Folds a samurai helmet from words only
blurb: No picture of the result: only one sentence. It writes its own plan, then picks folds from the menu.

goal.text: Fold a samurai helmet (kabuto) from one square sheet of paper (coloured on one side). It should be something you could wear: two horns sticking out at the top, a brim across the front, and an opening at the bottom for the head.
